independent_prediction.aggregation: maximum diagnostic A score among all candidate occurrences in fixed context; not target-aware

coverage: Complete planned requests required; no outcome-dependent dropping.
limitations: Source-selected fixed-context pilot; does not establish deployment prevalence or end-to-end retrieval gains.
Review fields record attestations; software cannot verify human independence.
Correlated random seeds averaged within task; no equivalence claim from a nonsignificant contrast.
Cluster intervals condition on the observed policy allocation; they do not reoptimize allocation in each resample.
Workload budgets assume the batch of questions/contexts is available; this is not an online optimal-allocation claim.

mechanism_annotation_coverage.note: This checks behavioral responses. It does not infer all error causes or prove neural causal mechanisms. Abstaining protocol differs from forced-choice budget protocol.

authoring_provenance.note: Different calls and isolated inputs do not imply independent human authors or independent model-family errors.
